Let me analyze this OIML Certificate of Conformity.

Document details:
- Certificate number: R76/2006-NL1-11.37, revision 1
- Project number: 11200385
- Page total: 2
- Member State: The Netherlands
- Date issued: 19 April 2012
- OIML issuer ID: NL1
- Scheme: not mentioned explicitly — R76/2006-NL1-11.37... The scheme letter (A or B) isn't stated. Omit.

Issuing authority:
- Name: NMi Certin B.V.
- Person responsible: C. Oosterman
- Title: Head Certification Board
- Address: Hugo de Grootplein 1, 3314 EG Dordrecht, the Netherlands
- Phone: +31 78 6332332
- Email: certin@nmi.nl
- Website: www.nmi.nl

Applicants:
- METTLER-TOLEDO Changzhou Measurement Technology Ltd., 111, West Taihu Road, XinBei District, Changzhou, Jiangsu, CHINA

Manufacturers:
- Same as applicant.

Certified type:
- Category: Weighing module — but this is an R76 certificate. The category in schema examples: "Indicator", "Weighing module"... The certificate says "A Weighing module". Category could be "Weighing module". Type designation: PBD655.

Recommendation:
- R76, edition 2006, accuracy class III.

Test reports:
- NMi-11200385-01 revision 1, dated 17 April 2012, 24 pages
- NMi-11200385-02 revision 1, dated 17 April 2012, 21 pages
- NMi-11200385-03 revision 1, dated 17 April 2012, 21 pages
- R76/2006-NL1-10.25 dated 18 November 2010, 49 pages

Characteristics:
- Maximum capacity: 6 kg ≤ Max ≤ 600 kg → range {min: 6, max: 600}, unit kg
- Verification scale interval: e ≥ 1 g → {min: 1, max: null}, unit g
- Maximum number of scale intervals: n ≤ 6000 divisions (single interval); n ≤ 3000 divisions (per partial weighing range). This is config-level: axis could be "weighing range type": single interval → 6000, per partial weighing range → 3000. Unit: divisions. Could put in config_level with axis "scale_interval_scope".
- Maximum partial weighing ranges: 2 → value 2, dimensionless.
- Temperature range: -10 °C / +40 °C → {min: -10, max: 40}, unit °C.

No model family — single type PBD655. Model family omitted (cert covers one model). Actually rule: include ONLY if cert covers >1 model variant. Single model, so omit.

Revision history: revision "1" — the certificate number is "R76/2006-NL1-11.37 revision 1". Date of revision? Date issued 19 April 2012. Revision history: revision 1, date 19 April 2012, changes null. Hmm, could include. The revision history array: revision "1", date 2012-04-19, changes: null. I'll include it.

Date format: 19 April 2012 → "2012-04-19".

Footnotes: none.

Characteristics structure:

type_level:
- maximum_capacity: {value: {min: 6, max: 600}, unit_symbol: "kg"}
- verification_scale_interval: {value: {min: 1, max: null}, unit_symbol: "g"}
- maximum_number_of_scale_intervals... hmm this varies by configuration: single interval vs per partial weighing range. Put in config_level:
  - attribute: maximum_number_of_scale_intervals, axis: weighing_range_scope, values: [{condition: "single interval", value: 6000, unit_symbol: "divisions"}, {condition: "per partial weighing range", value: 3000, unit_symbol: "divisions"}]
  Actually "divisions" — could be unit_symbol "divisions" or null. I'll use "divisions".
- maximum_partial_weighing_ranges: {value: 2, unit_symbol: null}
- temperature_range: {value: {min: -10, max: 40}, unit_symbol: "°C"}

Accuracy class: III → recommendation.accuracy_classes: ["III"].

Recommendation id: "R76", edition: 2006.

Test report roles: all are test reports ("OIML Test Report(s)"). Role: "test_report" for all four? The first three are numbered NMi-...; the fourth is R76/2006-NL1-10.25 which is a different certificate's test report perhaps. All role: "test_report". Pages: 24, 21, 21, 49. Dates: 2012-04-17 ×3, 2010-11-18.

Certificate scheme: The number format R76/2006-NL1-11.37 — no scheme letter. Omit scheme.

Category: "Weighing module" — per schema category examples like "Indicator". I'll use "Weighing module".

description: "Characteristics of the non-automatic weighing instrument" — could include a description but not necessary. Maybe description: null or omit. The schema says description free-text if present. I'll omit or include "A Weighing module"? Omit.

module_designation: null or omit. Omit.

Certificate page_total: 2.

oiml_issuer_id: "NL1" for certificate and issuing_authority.

Output JSON:

{
  "certificate": {
    "number": "R76/2006-NL1-11.37",
    "project_number": "11200385",
    "page_total": 2,
    "member_state": "The Netherlands",
    "date_issued": "2012-04-19",
    "oiml_issuer_id": "NL1"
  },
  "issuing_authority": {
    "name": "NMi Certin B.V.",
    "address_lines": ["Hugo de Grootplein 1", "3314 EG Dordrecht", "the Netherlands"],
    "person_responsible": "C. Oosterman",
    "person_title": "Head Certification Board",
    "phone": "+31 78 6332332",
    "email": "certin@nmi.nl",
    "website": "www.nmi.nl",
    "oiml_issuer_id": "NL1"
  },
  "applicants": [...],
  "manufacturers": [...],
  "certified_type": {
    "category": "Weighing module",
    "type_designations": ["PBD655"]
  },
  "recommendation": {
    "id": "R76",
    "edition": 2006,
    "accuracy_classes": ["III"]
  },
  "test_reports": [...],
  "revision_history": [{"revision": "1", "date": "2012-04-19"}],
  "characteristics": {
    "type_level": {...},
    "config_level": [...]
  }
}

For revision_history, changes omitted (null). Include date 2012-04-19.

Config level value structure: schema shows {condition, value} but rule 5 says values follow structured form {condition, value, unit_symbol}. So:

{"condition": "single interval", "value": 6000, "unit_symbol": "divisions"} — but "divisions" as unit symbol... scale intervals are dimensionless counts. I could use unit_symbol "divisions" or null. I'll use "divisions".

Actually, could also make two type_level attributes: max_number_of_scale_intervals_single_interval = 6000, and per partial weighing range = 3000. But config_level seems more apt. Alternatively use attribute "maximum_number_of_scale_intervals" with axis "weighing_range_scope". I'll do config_level.

Also "maximum_partial_weighing_ranges": 2.
